tools.name: ui_search
tools.description: Find UI kit entries (cem-ui registry/) whose id, name or any recorded field holds every word of the query. Returns the best matches, id first.

tools.name: ui_get
tools.description: One UI kit entry in full, as cem-ui registry/ records it: by id ("site-header", "shell", "spacing", "CRP:ask-cem-panel"), component tag ("x-site-header") or name.

tools.name: ui_laws
tools.description: The CEM design laws, cem-ui LAWS.md, the one rules document. Without a law, the whole file. With a number (1 to 20), that law as written. With words ("accent edge", "white"), every law that holds all of them.

tools.name: calculators_list
tools.description: The 21 CEM calculators, the same on every site (cem-ui registry/tools.json), with what each measures, and its page and formula code from CRP's search index when CRP is up.

tools.name: calculator_get

tools.name: research_search
tools.description: Find CEM research by words or code in CRP's public search index (GET /search/index.json): papers, playbooks, case studies, book chapters, figures, calculators and pages. Every word must match the title, full title, summary or code. Returns each result's code, title, kind and address.

tools.name: reviews_search
